protocol.name: discovery-benchmark-v3
protocol.information: Every strategy uses avval/search.py::SearchInterface: the public spec, the same visible per-run columns, the same budget. No strategy sees acceptance criteria, references' parameters, driver-model parameters or other campaigns.

regions.misuse_handback_collision: collision AND avoidable_by_reference AND handback_required AND driver_category = 'foreseeable_misuse'
regions.silent_margin_erosion: NOT collision AND NOT tor_issued AND min_ttc_accel < 2.0

robustness.definition: 0 if collision or end_state = 'horizon_unresolved'; else min(min_ttc, cap); a run that never closes (min_ttc NULL) scores cap

baselines.encoding: per scenario, (ego_speed, headway, scenario parameter, friction) scaled to [0, 1] by the public ranges; scenario and driver_state categorical

random.distribution: scenario and driver_state uniform; parameters uniform over the public ranges

cem.elite_pool: all runs so far (score <= elite quantile)
cem.continuous: Gaussian per scenario from elite mean/std, clipped to [0, 1]

boundary.bisection: midpoint to the nearest non-target run of the same scenario and driver state, jitter local_sigma / 4

bayesopt.kernel: Constant(1.0) * Matern(length_scale=0.3 per feature, nu=2.5) + White(0.1)
bayesopt.features: x in [0, 1]^4, is first scenario, is first driver state
bayesopt.acquisition: expected improvement below the best observed robustness
bayesopt.diversity: greedy by EI; squared feature distance > 0.01 between picks
bayesopt.ties: numpy argsort order (stable for equal EI)
